title: runs row
description: One schema, three statuses (03 L100): launched at launch, finished at the end, adopted when a run session takes over a launched, unfinished run; a relink version keeps the latest status and only changes handoff_id (03 L100; sync-inbox Q31). Field table 03 L102-120.

run_id.description: primary key; equals the artifact directory name, the tmux session and the commit message; artifact dir is <artifact_root>/<run_id>/ by convention and not recorded (03 L104; 08 L26)

actor.description: only the run role's scripts write this ledger; gyb is the principle-1 exception (03 L100)

command.description: launched: required, copied from the launch order (03 L108)

started_at.description: launched: required; filled by rl (03 L114; 05 L73)

config.description: launched: required, copied from the launch order (03 L115)

finished_at.description: finished: required; filled by rl (03 L116)

actual_seconds.description: finished: required; rl computes it from the two timestamps and copies it into the launch order's latest attempt (03 L118)

metrics.description: required when exit_status is ok; keys are metric names, values numbers (03 L119)

data_path.description: required when exit_status is ok: the file or sub-directory in the artifact dir that analysis computes from (03 L120)

x-conditions.then: written by rl handoff start; records the new holder's session_id and ts in the skeleton fields, no extra field (03 L100)

x-conditions.rule: relink version: status and every other field copied from the latest version, only handoff_id changes (doctor item 6)
default listing: only each order's latest attempt and only when its exit_status is ok; --all shows everything (03 L124)

x-pending: PENDING(part 23 L93): whether a finished version with exit_status failed or killed needs data_path
